How the two answers are computed

Where else. Three independent channels, fused by Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Clone: the bug hunk and the fix hunk are winnowed (k=5, w=2, driver prefix normalised so ath11k_x matches ath12k_x). A candidate scores high when it contains the bug pattern and not the fix. Lineage: same function after normalising ath10k/ath11k/ath12k/wifi7 prefixes. Shape: overlap of callees and firmware IDs. Then a verdict per candidate: Likely unfixed (bug ≥ 50%, fix < 30%), Already fixed (fix ≥ 60%), Review, or Not applicable when the fix needs a field or function this driver doesn’t have.

Impact. A call graph of all three drivers, including calls through ops tables (hal_ops, hw_ops, hif_ops). mac80211 callbacks mark user-visible entry points. WMI/HTT/HAL/QMI IDs mark firmware contracts, and partners show who else speaks the same message. Plane comes from the layer, and crossings are where control code calls data code or the reverse.

Limits. Regex-level C parsing, no preprocessor, so #ifdef branches and macro-generated functions are approximate. Ops resolution matches on member name, so it can over-connect. Every finding is a lead for a human, not a verdict.

Rekey must flush fragments

CVE-2020-24587 invariant: every key install must flush the RX fragment cache. ath11k does it (c3944a5621, 2021). In ath12k no call path from set_key reaches the fragment flush; it only runs on peer teardown, timeout or a new sequence number.

ath12k/ce.c:60 · bug pattern 100% · fix 0%
Fixed in ath11k on 2024-09-09: ath11k: modify null check logic in ath11k_ce_rx_post_pipe()
Still `if (!(pipe->dest_ring || pipe->status_ring)) return 0;` at ce.c:67. With only one ring allocated it carries on and dereferences the NULL one later. ath11k changed it to `||` of the negations.

0002-ath12k-ce-rx-post-pipe-null-check.patch
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: ath12k: modify null check logic in ath12k_ce_rx_post_pipe()ath12k_ce_rx_post_pipe() returns early only when both dest_ring andstatus_ring are NULL.
